newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's tax receipts down 12.9 pct in May - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's tax receipts down 12.9 pct in May - paper.

text.p: Brazil's federal tax receipts in May reached about 8.5 billion reais, down 12.9 percent from April, due to a reduction in income tax revenues, Gazeta Mercantil financial newspaper said on Wednesday.
May official figures have not been released yet.

The newspaper quoted an unnamed source at the Finance Ministry as saying that the drop in income tax receipts in May is related to changes in revenue collection procedures. But lower tax revenues between January and April were due to weaker economic activity, Gazeta said.

Despite last month's drop, the Brazilian government is likely to meet its target of collecting 105 billion reais this year, the paper said. So far this year, it has collected 44 billion reais, it added.
